summary: Results-driven **Software Engineer** with **9+ years of experience** designing and implementing **scalable cloud solutions** and **automation tools**. Currently accelerating **Azure sovereign cloud** and **new region buildouts** through **data analysis** and **automation** at **Microsoft**, with proven expertise in **Python**, **JavaScript**, **.NET**, and **modern web frameworks**. Strong track record of bridging technical implementation with business objectives and contributing to **open-source** projects.

education.name: Babeş-Bolyai University, Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science

subsections.description: Accelerate Azure sovereign cloud and new region buildouts by analyzing deployment data to uncover automation gaps, bottlenecks, and recurring errors, reducing buildout time.
Automate manual buildout steps across 3 sovereign cloud environments, eliminating human error and making deployments repeatable.
Perform root-cause analysis on buildout failures and delays across new region buildouts, identifying systemic issues (e.g., dependency ordering, retries, manual operations) and driving fixes.
Partner with 20+ Azure engineering teams to optimize their buildout workflows, turning analysis into prioritized, tracked improvements.

Build **Azure Data Explorer** and **Power BI** dashboards and **pandas/numpy** reports that track deployment status, automation progress, and standardization across buildouts and environments, giving visibility and driving **infrastructure-as-code** adoption across **Azure Core**.

Designed, developed, and maintained AltWalker, an **open-source Model-Based Testing framework** supporting **Python** and **.NET/C#**, downloaded 50K+ times and integrated by 20+ organizations into testing workflows.
Implemented and optimized **CI/CD pipelines** across **Jenkins**, **GitLab CI/CD**, and **GitHub Actions**, reducing deployment time by 30% and improving code quality metrics.
Led organization and supervision of online **Model-Based Testing workshops**, training **100+ participants** through hands-on practical exercises.

Built scalable **RESTful APIs** using **Flask** and **MongoDB**, and developed responsive web applications with **Ember.js** for test report visualization, optimizing response times to under 200ms for all endpoints.
Integrated **WebGL** support and cloud platforms (**BrowserStack**, **BitBar**) into test automation tools for **Unity applications**, expanding testing capabilities across mobile and web platforms.
Implemented **feature enhancements** and resolved **critical bugs** as part of an **agile development** team, contributing to 3 major product releases.
Participated in **peer programming sessions**, **code reviews**, and **daily stand-ups**, improving code quality and team collaboration.
Collaborated with senior developers to **enhance programming skills** and adopt **best practices** for software development.
